name: ImageNet
description: Large-scale hierarchical image dataset with over 14 million annotated images.

name: GLUE
description: General Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark for NLP models.

name: SuperGLUE
description: More challenging successor to GLUE with harder language understanding tasks.

name: COCO
description: Common Objects in Context — large image dataset for object detection and segmentation.

name: SQuAD
description: Stanford Question Answering Dataset — reading comprehension benchmark.

name: WMT
description: Workshop on Machine Translation — annual parallel corpora for MT evaluation.

name: LibriSpeech
description: Large-scale audio dataset of 1000 hours of read English speech.

name: MNIST
description: Handwritten digit recognition dataset — 70,000 labeled images of digits 0-9.

name: Common Crawl
description: Petabyte-scale web crawl corpus used to train large language models.

name: The Pile
description: 825 GiB diverse text corpus for training large language models.

name: LAION-5B
description: 5 billion image-text pairs from the web — used to train Stable Diffusion.
